description: Generate a barcode or QR code as SVG or PNG: QR, DataMatrix, PDF417, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, ISBN-13, ITF and GS1-128. EAN/UPC/ISBN check digits are computed (or verified, never silently replaced). QR and DataMatrix support colours, square/rounded/dot styles and (QR) a centre logo from an https URL. Every format is verified scannable. Returns SVG text or base64 PNG plus a data URI ready to embed in HTML, PDF or labels. Paid ($0.001, x402).

ec.description: QR error correction level (H when a logo is used)

height_mm.description: Bar height for linear barcodes, in mm

include_text.description: Print the human-readable text under linear barcodes

logo_url.description: QR only: https URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP logo (max 200 KB) placed in the centre

scale.description: Size: pixels per module (2D) or bar-width step (1D); default 4 (SVG) / 8 (PNG)

text.description: Data to encode (URL, text, digits for EAN/UPC/ISBN...)

name: generate_barcode
title: generate barcode
